episodes.name: Day of the Dumpster
episodes.overview: Rita Repulsa escapes after 10,000 years of imprisonment determined to conquer Earth but a team of teenagers with attitude stands in her way.

episodes.name: Food Fight
episodes.overview: Bulk and his gang seek to ruin the food festival while Rita sends a gluttonous pig to eat everything on Earth.

episodes.name: High Five
episodes.overview: Trini must overcome her fear of heights to save Billy.

episodes.name: Teamwork
episodes.overview: Kimberly and Trini gather signatures to close down a nearby dumpsite while convincing their teammates to work together more.

episodes.name: A Pressing Engagement
episodes.overview: Jason battles King Sphinx while trying to break a bench press record at the Angel Grove Gym & Juice Bar.

episodes.name: Different Drum
episodes.overview: Kimberly's deaf friend is the only hope to rescue a group of girls captured by the Gnarly Gnome and his hypnotic accordion.

episodes.name: I, Eye Guy
episodes.overview: Rita sends her monster Eye Guy to kidnap Billy's bright young protégé.

episodes.name: For Whom the Bell Trolls
episodes.overview: Trini's favorite doll is brought to life by Rita Repulsa and commanded to capture the Rangers inside bottles.

episodes.name: Happy Birthday, Zack
episodes.overview: Zack worries that his friends have forgotten today is his birthday while Rita sends him an unwelcome present.

episodes.name: No Clowning Around
episodes.overview: The gang fights Rita's minions at a carnival in order to save Trini's cousin Sylvia.

episodes.name: Power Ranger Punks
episodes.overview: The gang fights Rita's minions at a carnival in order to save Trini's cousin Sylvia.

episodes.name: Peace, Love and Woe
episodes.overview: Baboo sneaks a magic potion into Kimberly and Billy's drinks that turns them into angry punks.

episodes.name: Foul Play in the Sky
episodes.overview: Billy draws on the powers of his friends to rescue the girl of his dreams.

episodes.name: Dark Warrior
episodes.overview: Billy is inspired by Trini's uncle Howard - a brilliant scientist and expert in martial arts.

episodes.name: Big Sisters
episodes.overview: Kimberly and Trini look after a mischievous little girl named Maria.

episodes.name: Switching Places
episodes.overview: Billy's latest invention goes haywire causing him and Kimberly to switch bodies.

episodes.name: Green with Evil Part 1: Out of Control
episodes.overview: Rita creates her own evil Green Ranger to beat the Power Rangers at their own game.

episodes.name: Green with Evil Part 2: Jason's Battle
episodes.overview: The Power Rangers work to restore Zordon and Alpha unaware that the new kid in school is actually Rita's evil Green Ranger.

episodes.name: Green with Evil Part 3: The Rescue
episodes.overview: Femme fatale Scorpina joins Rita as the Green Ranger continues to battle the Power Rangers.

episodes.name: Green with Evil Part 4: Eclipsing Megazord
episodes.overview: An eclipse of the sun saps the Megazord's power as Rita's forces launch a full scale assault on Angel Grove.

episodes.name: Green with Evil Part 5: Breaking the Spell
episodes.overview: The mighty Dragonzord awakes after thousands of years as the Rangers try to break the spell over the Green Ranger once and for all.

episodes.name: The Trouble with Shellshock
episodes.overview: Squatt and Baboo create their own Shellshock monster to impress Rita.

episodes.name: The Spit Flower
episodes.overview: Rita and her evil Spit Flower monster set out to ruin Kimberly's design for a float in the world peace parade.

episodes.name: Itsy Bitsy Spider
episodes.overview: Zack must overcome his fear of spiders to face Rita's newest monster.

episodes.name: Life's a Masquerade
episodes.overview: Rita's Frankenstein monster crashes the Power Rangers' Halloween costume party.

episodes.name: Gung Ho!
episodes.overview: Jason and Tommy must learn to work together to stop Rita's Super Putties.

episodes.name: Wheel of Misfortune
episodes.overview: Rita turns Kimberly's grandmother's spinning wheel into her dangerous new weapon.

episodes.name: Island of Illusion (1)
episodes.overview: Rita traps the Power Rangers on the Island of Illusion, where their greatest fears can destroy them.

episodes.name: Island of Illusion (2)
episodes.overview: The Rangers must overcome their own fears to escape Rita's Island of Illusion.

episodes.name: The Rockstar
episodes.overview: Jason and his cousin Jeremy find a map that leads to a powerful ancient mirror.

episodes.name: Calamity Kimberly
episodes.overview: Kimberly's day goes from bad to worse when the Samurai Fanman captures her.

episodes.name: A Star is Born
episodes.overview: Tommy is called to rescue his friends while given the opportunity to audition for a martial arts commercial.

episodes.name: The Yolk's on You!
episodes.overview: With the Angel Grove High talent show around the corner, the Rangers have a lot to deal with when Tommy is kidnapped and imprisoned by putties, and Finster creates the Fang monster in celebration of Rita's birthday.

episodes.name: The Green Candle (1)
episodes.overview: Rita uses a green candle to wipe out the Green Ranger once and for all.

episodes.name: The Green Candle (2)
episodes.overview: As Jason journeys to the dimensional prison to stop the green candle from burning out, Tommy battles the Cyclops with the Dragonzord.

episodes.name: Birds of a Feather
episodes.overview: While Zack trains a young student for a karate tournament, Rita sends her Hatchasaurus monster down to Earth.

episodes.name: Clean-Up Club
episodes.overview: The Ranger teens form a Clean-Up Club and take part in cleaning up Angel Grove Park, but Rita has plans of her own and sends the Polluticorn monster after them.

episodes.name: A Bad Reflection on You
episodes.overview: Rita creates a team of evil duplicates of the Power Rangers to frame them.

episodes.name: Doomsday (1)
episodes.overview: Rita unveils her own evil Zord as she brings her entire palace from the Moon to Angel Grove.

episodes.name: Doomsday (2)
episodes.overview: The Power Rangers fight to rescue the citizens of Angel Grove from Rita, Lokar and Cyclopsis.

episodes.name: Rita's Seed of Evil
episodes.overview: While the Rangers plant trees in the park, Squatt plants an evil seed that grows into the Octoplant.

episodes.name: A Pig Surprise
episodes.overview: Rita casts a spell on a helpless pig turning him into the Pudgy Pig monster.

episodes.name: Something Fishy
episodes.overview: Billy must overcome his fear of fish to save his friends from Rita's fishy new monster.

episodes.name: Lions & Blizzards
episodes.overview: Zack finally gets a date with the girl of his dreams at the same time as Rita turns the Noble Lion Trophy into her latest monster.

episodes.name: Crystal of Nightmares
episodes.overview: The teens go to the mountains for the weekend to study for a test while Goldar readies the Crystal of Nightmares to infiltrate the Rangers' dreams.

episodes.name: To Flea or Not to Flee
episodes.overview: Jason tries to find the owner of a stray dog while the Rangers try to save Ernie's Gym & Juice Bar from going out of business.

episodes.name: Reign of the Jellyfish
episodes.overview: Rita--determined to prevent future generations from remembering the Power Rangers--tries to stop them from burying a time capsule.

episodes.name: Plague of the Mantis
episodes.overview: Trini struggles to learn praying mantis style kung fu to defeat Rita's latest monster.

episodes.name: Return of an Old Friend (1)
episodes.overview: Rita demands the Power Rangers hand over their Power Coins if they ever want to see their parents again.

episodes.name: Return of an Old Friend (2)
episodes.overview: With their Power Coins in the hands of the enemy the Rangers have no choice but to turn to Tommy once more for help.

episodes.name: Grumble Bee
episodes.overview: Billy gets his first 'B' on a science test giving Rita the idea to send her Grumble Bee to Earth.

episodes.name: Two Heads are Better Than One
episodes.overview: Jason and Tommy teach a self-defense class to women while the Rangers fight a two-headed parrot monster.

episodes.name: Fowl Play
episodes.overview: Zack juggles watching over a group of children with battling the Peckster.

episodes.name: Trick or Treat
episodes.overview: Kimberly competes against Skull on a game show for a chance to win a brand new car while the Pumpkin Rapper seeks to ambush the Rangers.

episodes.name: Second Chance
episodes.overview: Jason and Zack coach a young boy to help him make Ernie's junior soccer team.

episodes.name: On Fins and Needles
episodes.overview: The Slippery Shark monster casts a spell over Jason and Tommy causing them to fight amongst each other.

episodes.name: Enter... The Lizzinator
episodes.overview: Kimberly helps her younger cousin try out for the Angel Grove Junior High cheerleading team while Rita sends the mighty Lizzinator to Earth.

episodes.name: Football Season
episodes.overview: Tommy tries to learn how to play football in time to make the high school team and to stop Rita's Rhino Blaster.

episodes.name: Mighty Morphin' Mutants
episodes.overview: Tommy works on improving his memory while Rita creates a team of evil Mutant Rangers led by Commander Crayfish.

episodes.name: An Oyster Stew
episodes.overview: Zack seeks to impress Angela by giving her a pair of pearl earrings, unaware they are Rita's cursed Pearls of Stillness.
